name: Bank of Communications Co., Ltd.
via: Ministry of Finance of the PRC was the controlling shareholder with 35.02% of combined A and H shares as at 31 December 2025 (SSE 601328 / HKEX 03328); the National Council for Social Security Fund held a further 13.75%
note: Shareholding per the bank's 2025 annual report (English H-share edition, published 27 April 2026). A mid-2025 filing with the US Federal Reserve gave the older figure of 23.88% for the Ministry of Finance; the ministry increased its holding during 2025.
